title: HomeWorth
subtitle: MACHINE LEARNING & PREDICTIVE ANALYTICS
sideText: TURN HOUSING DATA INTO INTELLIGENT PREDICTIONS
description: A machine learning-based house price prediction system that analyzes housing features and estimates property values using regression algorithms. The project includes data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, and evaluation to transform raw housing data into meaningful predictions.
impact: Developed an end-to-end machine learning pipeline using the California Housing Dataset, comparing regression models and evaluating predictive performance through RMSE and cross-validation.

howItWorks.title: Data Preprocessing
howItWorks.description: Cleans housing data, handles missing values, engineers useful features, and prepares numerical and categorical inputs for machine learning.

howItWorks.title: Model Training
howItWorks.description: Trains and compares regression algorithms, including Linear Regression, Decision Tree, and Random Forest, to estimate house values.

howItWorks.title: Price Prediction
howItWorks.description: Processes housing features through the trained machine learning pipeline to generate an estimated property value.
